name: Bars Pulse Swap
description: Six vertical bars in pairs that pulse and swap positions

variations.name: default
variations.description: Six bars arranged in three pairs that continuously pulse while swapping between stacked and overlapped positions

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader container in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader container in pixels

props.name: barWidth
props.description: Width of each individual bar in pixels

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between bar pairs in pixels

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Controls whether the animation runs. Set to false to pause animation.
